reason: I already know we do some free work, that's how we keep clients. A report listing every freebie doesn't change the fact that I'm not going to ring a client of ten years and tell them their bill's going up. I might take the free audit out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay £240 a month for it.
objection: Finding the money is the easy bit. Asking for it is what I hate, and a script won't make me do it. Paying every month to be reminded of money I'm choosing not to bill feels like a waste.
would_change_my_mind: If the free audit turned up a lot of clearly unbilled licences or contracted time, say £10k or more, that I could invoice without it feeling like a price rise, rather than goodwill work I'd have to argue about.
